jobs.description:
Transformational Change Manager | Financial Services | Copenhagen, Denmark

Are you ready to lead teams and drive impactful change at scale for financial services clients? Are you passionate about helping organizations successfully navigate transformation, and do you bring both strategic vision and hands-on delivery experience? Then the role of Transformational Change Manager in Copenhagen is your next career move. Let’s build the future of work—together.

About the Team and the Role

As a Manager within our Talent team, based in Copenhagen, Denmark, you will take ownership of end-to-end project delivery, client relationships, and account management, with financial services as your primary industry focus. You will guide teams in co-creating and implementing human-centered transformation strategies, develop change approaches that are agile and ready for the digital world, and ensure the realization of measurable business outcomes.

You will work primarily with leading financial services clients, including banks, insurance providers, and capital markets firms, partnering with them on digital, technology-driven, and organizational transformations. You will be part of multidisciplinary teams delivering large, complex programs, working closely with client teams and international colleagues to solve challenging organizational problems, lead key workstreams, guide junior colleagues, and deliver specific project outcomes. Explore our point of view and Talent offering here.

The Work

• Lead Transformation Journeys – Help financial services clients navigate complex transformations, building organizations that are more capable, resilient, and adaptable to redirection and ambiguity.

• Human-Centered Change Strategies – Translate strategic direction and business objectives into holistic, agile change strategies that address culture, ways of working, and readiness for the future.

• Deep Change Management Expertise – Drive leadership alignment to the change vision, activate change using insight-driven approaches leveraging AI, engage large-scale change networks, and prepare organizations for business readiness, technology adoption, and new ways of working.

• Workforce Reinvention – Shape organization design, reskilling, and upskilling strategies for new operating models (e.g., S/4HANA, GBS, human-agentic workforce) and prepare the workforce for emerging roles.

• Technology Enablement – Unlock the human potential of new technologies through enterprise-wide system implementations, digital learning platforms, and AI-enabled change activation.

• Data-Driven Insights – Use analytics and predictive tools to measure adoption, sentiment, and transformation impact.

• Stakeholder Engagement & Account Management – Build trusted relationships with C-level executives and client teams in financial services, oversee account health, and proactively identify opportunities to expand our footprint.

• Business Development – Build trusted client relationships, identifying new growth opportunities, supporting business development activities, and shaping go-to-market strategies.

You will also:

• Lead workstreams and coach junior colleagues, bringing together cross-functional teams and specialists.

• Collaborate with Financial Services clients, the Netherlands & Nordics Talent practice and Accenture’s international network of experts.

• Balance changing priorities and timelines while keeping delivery focused on practical, measurable outcomes.

• Contribute to an inclusive, supportive team culture and continue developing your expertise in Change & Transformation Management.

About You

You bring a background in management consulting, organizational change or business transformation, with experience delivering people-centered change in complex, technology-enabled programs. You understand the opportunities and challenges facing banks, insurers and capital markets firms as they modernize systems, redesign operating models and introduce new ways of working. Your project experience may include roles such as Change Manager, Transformation Lead, Organizational Change Lead, Change and Communications Lead or Business Project Manager.

You are passionate about the people side of transformation and about turning strategic ambitions into meaningful, measurable change. You can align leaders around a shared vision, engage stakeholders and change networks, and shape communication, training and adoption activities that help people embrace new technologies, processes and behaviors. You use data and feedback to assess readiness, measure adoption and improve your approach iteratively.

You are comfortable leading workstreams and multidisciplinary teams in fast-paced, complex environments, combining strategic thinking with hands-on delivery. You build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, coach junior colleagues and solve problems in a people-oriented, insight-driven way. Most importantly, you are a collaborative colleague who helps teams navigate uncertainty and achieve outcomes together.

Requirements

• 
5+ years of relevant experience in organizational change, future workforce and/ or Human Resources; for example, guiding organizations in their transformation journey, designing and implementing large-scale communication and training programs, or upskill leaders to carry out desired behaviors.

• 
Management consulting experience or experience working within Financial Services, is a plus, not a prerequisite

• 
Strong consulting skills and the ability to engage senior business and HR stakeholders

• 
Strong self-leadership, with experience leading workstreams, collaborating in teams and coaching junior colleagues

• 
Understanding of organizational change and transformation components and complexicty, preferably within financial services and knowledge of banking, insurance, or capital markets transformation challenges

• 
A commercial mindset, the ability to build trusted client networks and a focus on measurable business and workforce outcomes

• 
Experience collaborating with cross-functional project teams in a global environment

• 
Professional proficiency in English; Danish language skills is an advantage for local client engagement, but not a requirement

• 
Track record as people-oriented, insight driven and iterative problem solver

• 
A master’s degree in a relevant field, such as business, engineering, or behavioral and social sciences

What We Offer

• Membership in our growing Netherlands & Nordics Talent team, with access to a global network of experts at the forefront of talent reinvention

• The opportunity to shape your career around your aspirations, with regular support from your People Lead

• A competitive salary, bonus schemes, health insurance, an employee share purchase program, and other benefits

• A strong commitment to employee well-being and work-life balance, including flexible arrangements that support family life, mental health, and well-being

• A supportive, encouraging and fun team who always roots for one another

• Market-leading expertise, a steep learning curve and great opportunities for development

• Opportunities to participate in corporate citizenship initiatives, including volunteering, charity work, and Inclusion & Diversity networks

Ready to Apply?

We would be delighted to hear from you. Please apply online and attach your CV and cover letter.

Do you want to be a valued part of the critical infrastructure that serves communities across Europe and beyond? Are you looking for an opportunity where you can make an impact, shape decisions, and accelerate your career?

If so, we are looking for dedicated, curious, and highly motivated graduates to join the DFDS Graduate Programme starting in September 2027.

**Be part of the movement - and play your part

**About The Role The DFDS Graduate Programme is a two-year fast-track programme for recent graduates with an interest in and passion for the maritime industry.

During the programme, you will complete three rotations across different areas of our Ferry Division. You will begin at our headquarters in Copenhagen, followed by a mandatory international rotation at one of our European hubs. Your final rotation at our headquarters will be tailored to your skills, interests, and our business needs.

Throughout the programme, you will gain broad exposure to both the operational and commercial sides of our Ferry Division while building valuable industry knowledge and professional experience.

Ferry Operations offers broad end-to-end exposure with sustainability, standardisation, and digitalisation at the heart of everything we do.

**Examples Of Interesting Tasks Could Be To:

**

• Help design and develop the vessels of tomorrow, supporting our green transition through electrification, ammonia, and green methanol initiatives.

• Support the operation and maintenance of our fleet of more than 70 RoRo, RoPax, and passenger vessels, covering everything from dry dock planning to crisis management and contingency handling.

• Contribute to our standardisation and digitalisation journey across eight owned terminals and more than 20 third-party terminals, where safety remains our highest priority.

• Support fleet planning, equipment optimisation, and our intercontinental rail setup, connecting ferry and logistics operations across our network.

In the commercial part of our Ferry Division, you will work alongside colleagues across Europe, supporting both B2B and B2C markets.

**Examples Of Interesting Tasks Could Be To:

**

• Support local and global sales teams and assist with key account management, ensuring our network is successfully marketed and sold across regions.

• Drive continuous improvement in customer service and booking processes through standardisation and digitalisation initiatives.

• Collaborate with IT teams to enhance and optimise our digital customer offerings.

• Work with operational teams to optimise routes and vessel capacity to meet customer demand.

• Support revenue management activities, including pricing optimisation and commercial performance analysis.

Across all rotations, you will work closely with highly skilled colleagues and engage with customers, suppliers, and partners throughout the maritime value chain. To support your development, each rotation will include both a dedicated manager and a mentor who will help you successfully navigate your learning journey.

Alongside hands-on experience at DFDS, you will participate in the Danish Shipping Education Programme, delivered by Danish Shipping. This programme consists of webinars, four seminars in Denmark, and one international seminar, covering key topics across the maritime industry.

****About You

****At DFDS, we believe the strongest teams are built on diversity, inclusion, and different perspectives. We are looking for candidates who:

• Have graduated from a relevant master’s degree by the start of the Graduate Programme in September 2027, preferably within maritime studies, supply chain, freight forwarding, logistics, sustainability, business, finance, engineering, or a related field.

• Have gained relevant experience through a student job, internship, exchange programme, or other extracurricular activities.

• Have no more than two years of full-time professional experience after completing your master's degree.

• Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Are collaborative team players who enjoy working with others and creating impact.

• Are curious, proactive, and eager to learn and develop professionally.

• Have an international mindset and are excited about working across cultures and locations.

Working at DFDS **Join the movement and grow with us

**As part of the DFDS Graduate Programme, you will become part of a strong graduate network across the company and build valuable connections across our international business. We offer a steep learning curve, meaningful responsibility from day one, and three interesting rotations designed to accelerate your professional development.

Are we a match? Apply now.  If your skills, experience, aspirations, and personality match this opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

Please Apply By Uploading Your CV no Later Than 30 November 2026. When Applying, You’re Also Asked To Answer The Following Questions:

• Why are you interested in joining the DFDS Graduate Programme?

• How will the programme help kickstart your career?

• How do you expect to contribute to the programme and DFDS?

• What do you believe will be your biggest challenge(s) during the programme?

**We look forward to hearing from you.

**Visit our Graduate site here to learn more and meet some of our people.

Description & Expectation:

Quadsat is looking for an experienced Product Manager to join the R&D team and take a key role in shaping and driving our defence product portfolio.

You will join the R&D organisation and work at the intersection of technology, customers, and business. The role combines strategic product management, defining product direction, priorities, positioning, and roadmap, with the operational responsibility of turning that direction into clear development priorities and ensuring progress across the organisation.

Our defence products combine RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into integrated solutions for the detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

You will work closely with engineering, commercial teams, partners, and end users to understand operational needs, translate market and customer insight into product priorities, manage and communicate the product roadmap, and help drive development from early concepts through product releases and continued improvement.

This is a role for someone who enjoys moving between the big picture and the detail: understanding where the product needs to go, while also staying close enough to development, customers, and delivery to help make it happen.

For this role it is a requirement that you can confirm that you are eligible to be security cleared by the Danish Defense Intelligence Service.

Responsibilities: 

Your main responsibility will be to take end-to-end ownership of product development and evolution. You will:

• Own and drive product roadmaps aligned with Quadsat's strategy, market opportunities, and customer needs.
• Translate customer, operational, and commercial input into clear product priorities and development initiatives.
• Drive development from concept through implementation, validation, release, and continued improvement.
• Maintain an overview of scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and progress, and communicate product status clearly across the organisation.
• Work closely with engineers and technical leads to understand feasibility, effort, and realistic timelines for new capabilities and customer requests.
• Collaborate with the R&D Director on prioritisation, resource planning, and allocation of engineering capacity across product lines.
• Facilitate collaboration across R&D, Business Development, Marketing, Production, Quality, and other key stakeholders.
• Stay close to customers, partners, and the defence industry, working with the commercial organisation to understand emerging needs and translate them into product direction.
The role offers significant ownership and the opportunity to influence both what we build and how we bring it to market, while remaining closely involved in the technical development required to make it happen.

Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in an engineering field, combined with strong practical experience in a similar role as a product or project manager.

In addition, you bring:

• Experience translating customer or market needs into technical products and development priorities.
• Experience within product management, technical product management, technical project management, or a similar role.
• Experience from the defence industry or another mission-critical technical domain.
• A strong technical understanding and the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
• Fluency in English (both written and oral).

Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.

Description & Expectation

Quadsat is looking for an experienced RF Systems Architect to join the RF team working on SpectraLoc, our defense product for detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

This role will focus on RF front-end architecture, coherent receiver design, RF chain optimization, PCB design and layout, measurement integrity, and the continued productization of SpectraLoc. You will help strengthen the RF hardware foundation needed for robust product performance, certification readiness, and future next-generation RF architectures.

SpectraLoc combines RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into one integrated product. You will work closely with engineers spanning from RF, DSP, software, embedded, and FPGA specialist, with your primary focus being to improve RF system quality, hardware robustness, and the measurement integrity of the sensing chain.

For this role it is a requirement that you can confirm that you are eligible to be security cleared by the Danish Defense Intelligence Service.

Responsibilities: 

Your main responsibility will be to develop, improve, and mature RF hardware and RF system architectures that support reliable RF sensing, geolocation, and future coherent receiver capabilities.

You will:

• Design, develop, and optimize RF front-end architectures for RF sensing and geolocation applications.
• Contribute to coherent receiver design, multi-channel RF architectures, and future direction-finding capabilities based on phase-coherent RF measurements.
• Design and improve RF chains, including filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, gain distribution, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, and sensitivity trade-offs.
• Support PCB design and layout for RF circuits, including component selection, schematic design, layout review, signal integrity, grounding, shielding, and manufacturability.
• Improve measurement integrity across the RF sensing chain by identifying and reducing sources of uncertainty, drift, phase error, loss, interference, leakage, and calibration sensitivity.
• Plan and perform RF measurements, verification, and troubleshooting using relevant RF test equipment such as spectrum analysers, VNAs, signal generators, power meters, and related tools.
• Work with DSP and software engineers to ensure that RF hardware behavior, calibration data, and system limitations are understood and properly reflected in algorithm development and product performance.
• Support product robustness, certification readiness, and design-for-manufacturing activities by improving RF hardware quality, documentation, repeatability, and testability.
• Provide technical leadership within RF systems and hardware, helping raise the quality of Quadsat’s RF design, validation methodology, and overall sensing performance.

Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Microwave Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field, combined with strong practical experience in RF hardware development for RF sensing, SDR, radar, electronic warfare, SATCOM, aerospace, telecom, test and measurement, or other advanced RF systems.

More important than the exact degree is that you have hands-on experience designing, validating, and improving RF systems where measurement quality, robustness, and system performance matter.

In addition, you bring:

• Strong practical experience with RF front-end design, RF chain architecture, and RF hardware development.
• Experience with RF circuit design and PCB design/layout for high-frequency systems.
• Solid understanding of RF system trade-offs, including gain, noise figure, dynamic range, linearity, filtering, frequency conversion, phase noise, spurious signals, leakage, and sensitivity.
• Practical experience with RF measurement, verification, debugging, and calibration using professional RF test equipment.
• Understanding of coherent RF systems, including phase stability, synchronization, channel matching, LO distribution, timing effects, and calibration considerations.
• Familiarity with antenna interfaces, propagation effects, polarization, multipath, and how RF hardware behavior affects sensing and geolocation performance.
• Ability to define test methods, performance metrics, acceptance criteria, and validation approaches for RF hardware and RF sensing systems.
• Experience collaborating with DSP, software, embedded, FPGA, mechanical, robotics, and product teams to turn RF hardware concepts into robust product capabilities.
• A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to work independently while staying aligned with broader product and engineering priorities.
It would be highly advantageous if you also have experience with electronic warfare, radar systems, SIGINT, RF surveillance, phased arrays, coherent multi-channel receivers, interferometry, monopulse tracking, beamforming, calibration of RF sensing systems, MIL-STD certification, environmental robustness, SDR platforms, or transitioning RF hardware from prototype into production.

Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

**Job Requisition ID #

**26WD101877

**Principal Embedded Engineer, AI Solutions

****Position Overview

**Autodesk Technical Advisory is seeking a highly technical and customer-focused Embedded Engineer, AI Solutions to join our new Embedded Engineering (forward-deployed engineering) team.

You will work directly alongside strategic Autodesk customers to discover high-value workflows, model the data those workflows depend on, and build the AI systems for their Design & Make workflows to enable customer’s measurable business outcomes.

You will move fluidly from understanding a customer's workflow and architecture to writing code. You will spend your weeks writing production code to build agents and orchestration, retrieval and graph services, connectors and APIs - inside customer environments, alongside customer engineers. What you ship is concrete: AI agents, MCP servers and tools, domain and semantic models, knowledge-graph extensions, retrieval and context-resolution pipelines, integrations into ERP, PLM, BIM, enterprise data platforms, and eval harnesses to move new capabilities into production.

Unlike traditional project delivery, Embedded Engineering works deeply inside customer environments, connecting Autodesk technology and data with the rest of the enterprise. Insights developed through customer work will be translated into reusable agents, connectors, reference architectures, engineering patterns, and direct product feedback that shapes Autodesk's platform roadmap.

The successful candidate combines strong software and AI engineering skills with curiosity, customer empathy, business judgment, and the ability to operate independently when the problem is not yet well defined. This role is engagement-driven with travel up to 75% during active engagements, including extended periods working onsite with customers.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.

**Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed below.

**Responsibilities

****Discover Workflows and Own the Outcome

**

• Partner with customer executives, business leaders, and technical teams to translate transformation objectives, operational KPIs, sustainability commitments, and digital initiatives into measurable, AI-enabled workflow outcomes.

• Lead co-innovation with customers to find high-value workflows, decision bottlenecks, data requirements, and integration opportunities, turning ambiguous business challenges into clear technical directions.

• Analyze end-to-end workflows across Autodesk and non-Autodesk systems to pinpoint friction, process inefficiency, data gaps, and the places where AI and agents genuinely change the economics.

• Own technical execution end-to-end - rapid prototype through architecture, build, integration, testing, governance, production deployment guidance, and adoption - with accountability for customer impact.

• Sequence the work and decide what not to build. Make explicit trade-offs between scope, speed, and durability, and defend them to both customer and Autodesk stakeholder

**Make Data and Context AI-Ready

**

• Assess customer data readiness - fragmented sources, ownership, quality, lineage, metadata, governance, permissioning, and integration constraints - required to support trusted AI and agentic workflows.

• Structure and connect design intent, project, product, and asset data, along with requirements, supporting evidence, approvals, decisions, and dependencies, into trusted AI-ready data and context models that enable reasoning, retrieval, and agentic action.

• Design ontologies, semantic layers, and knowledge graphs that business users recognize and agents can act on, including entity resolution across source systems, schema mapping, and permission models that survive contact with enterprise reality.

**Build and Ship Production AI

**

• Design and build production-grade AI-enabled workflows, agents, applications, and integrations that connect Autodesk products and platform capabilities with customers' broader enterprise technology environments.

• Build the retrieval and context layer these systems depend on - hybrid search, graph-grounded retrieval, tool interfaces, and MCP servers that expose governed enterprise context to agents safely.

• Make quality measurable. Build evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, guardrails, tracing, and observability so that agent behavior is testable before launch and monitored after it, and so that quality regressions and drift are caught in production rather than reported by users.

• Apply strong engineering practices across architecture, code quality, security, permissions, reliability, observability, testing, performance, and maintainability, adapting quickly to complex and constrained customer environments.

• Define the operating model for what you build - runbooks, ownership, escalation, and cost - and hand it over cleanly to customer teams or Autodesk services so value persists after the engagement ends.

**Feed the Product and Build Reusable IP

**

• Act as a frontline product discovery mechanism, translating customer learning into prioritized product requirements, platform capability gaps, roadmap recommendations, and opportunities for feature or API acceleration.

• Convert customer-specific learning into reusable Autodesk value - reference architectures, agent and MCP patterns, connectors, ontology templates, graph models, reusable code, evals, and technical playbooks - that reduces the cost of every engagement that follows.

**Build an AI-Native Practice

**

• Design, build, and operationalize the agents, workflows, and automations that make the Embedded Engineering organization itself faster and more effective, measuring success by both customer impact and scalable internal leverage. Continuously look for manual work to replace with agentic systems and reusable internal tooling.

• Stay at the frontier. Maintain working knowledge of new model capabilities, agent implementation patterns, and AI product development stacks, and bring what's genuinely useful into practice.

• Serve as a trusted technical advisor across the boundary - partnering with customer engineers, architects, and business leaders, and with Autodesk Sales, Customer Success, Technical Advisory, Product, and Platform teams - to unblock delivery and help teams navigate ambiguity, trade-offs, risk, and changing requirements.

**Minimum Qualifications

**

• 6+ years building and operating production software, including 2+ in a customer-facing or embedded role (forward-deployed or founding engineer). CS/Engineering degree or equivalent hands-on experience.

• Full-stack range. Expert Python plus one of TypeScript, Java, or C# - comfortable across backend, data pipelines, integrations, and a lightweight React surface when a workflow needs one.

• Cloud fluency in Azure or AWS: containers, serverless, managed data stores, and identity and networking inside customer-governed environments (e.g., infrastructure as code with Terraform, Bicep, or CloudFormation), with strong API, distributed-systems, CI/CD, and observability fundamentals.

• Agentic systems in production. You've built and run single- and multi-agent systems - tool schemas, memory, human-in-the-loop checkpoints - on a modern orchestration framework (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, Bedrock AgentCore, etc), MCP making practical cost and latency trade-offs (e.g., model selection, caching).

• Evaluation as engineering. You build golden datasets and eval harnesses from real customer data, and you measure groundedness, task success, and retrieval quality using standard tooling (e.g., RAGAS, LangSmith, Langfuse).

• Retrieval and data readiness. You've built retrieval systems end-to-end (chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking) over a vector store and can assess and fix messy enterprise data - lineage, permissions, entity resolution, schema mapping.

• Knowledge architecture for AI. You model domain semantics into AI-ready context - ontologies, semantic layers, knowledge graphs - and ground agents in it via GraphRAG or equivalent, using at least one graph technology (e.g., Azure Cosmos DB Gremlin, Amazon Neptune, Neo4j, or equivalent) and its query language (e.g. Gremlin, Cypher, SPARQL).

• Ownership under ambiguity. You take greenfield customer problems from framing to production and measured outcomes and can explain a non-deterministic system with equal credibility to an engineer and an executive.

**Work arrangement

**

• You'll work with one customer at a time on focused engagements, for specified duration, on-site at customer locations that may be outside your home country, with travel of up to 75%, subject to any immigration or other requirements (averages likely to be lower across the whole year). You remain an Autodesk employee throughout, and the intention is that Autodesk's policies, benefits, and time off apply on every assignment. Some customers may have their own onboarding, safety, security or other requirements, which will be discussed with you at the time.

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Domain fluency in AECO, with the ability to ramp quickly on design-to-construction-to-operations processes.

• Autodesk platform fluency: Autodesk Platform Services (APS), AEC Data Model API, Autodesk Construction Cloud and Common Data Environment (CDE) concepts, Forma, Fusion, Flow, and Autodesk data models.

• Enterprise systems of record integration: ERP, PDM, PLM, BIM, project controls, cost, scheduling, and asset management, plus enterprise data platforms (data lakes, warehouses, Lakehouse, analytics platforms).

About the role

You’ll help shape the architecture of a live AI product running on our own on-prem LLM stack.

Two big projects are coming up, and you’ll play a key part in both:

• Voice-to-workflow: making speech a first-class input channel in our agentic workflows

• Moving to a graph architecture: going from RAG to GraphRAG by building a knowledge graph and integrating it into our existing pipeline

Responsibilities

Shape the architecture of a live AI product

• Evaluate and challenge design decisions across the stack, including retrieval strategies, LLM backend selection, service boundaries and data flow, and propose improvements with clear reasoning

• Take part in technical planning with the team and with insurance-domain stakeholders, turning vague requirements into concrete engineering tasks

• Identify technical debt, assess its cost and make the case for addressing it

Develop and optimize our on-prem AI stack

• Further develop and optimize our self-hosted LLM stack: local models, local embedding and on-prem vector stores

• Evaluate open-weight LLMs for Danish-language RAG quality, weighing latency, accuracy and hardware requirements

Move to a graph architecture (RAG → GraphRAG)

• Help design and build a knowledge graph for our domain, including ontology and knowledge extraction

• Integrate the knowledge graph into our existing RAG pipeline and measure the effect on retrieval quality

Design and build agentic workflows

• Design multi-step agent architectures using LangGraph or equivalent frameworks that can route, plan, use tools and synthesize across document corpora

• Define tool-use interfaces, memory patterns and failure-handling strategies for agent loops running in production

• Work with domain experts to identify automation opportunities worth building

Enable voice-to-workflow capabilities

• Help design a pipeline that integrates local speech-to-text models into agentic workflows

• Evaluate Danish-language ASR quality, identify gaps and assess whether fine-tuning or model selection is the better approach

• Design the integration points carefully, with attention to latency, error handling and data privacy, so voice becomes a first-class input channel

Requirements

• 2–4 years of production Python engineering experience, including async code, clean architecture patterns and testable codebases

• Direct experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain or similar) in a shipped product or serious project

• Solid understanding of RAG systems: chunking strategies, embedding models, vector search and retrieval quality evaluation

• Familiarity with vector databases such as pgvector, Chroma, Weaviate or Pinecone

• Comfortable owning a FastAPI service end-to-end: schema design, error handling, auth,

• containerization and deployment

• Ability to reason about architectural trade-offs and communicate them clearly

• Hands-on experience designing or running local LLM inference (Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp) in a real rather than toy context

Nice to have

• Familiarity with knowledge graphs, including ontology building, knowledge extraction and RAG integration (especially relevant)

• Speech-to-text pipeline work (Whisper, Deepgram, Speechmatics or comparable local STT), especially on non-English languages (especially relevant)

• Experience with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) or custom tool-use and planning loops in production

• Hybrid retrieval systems (dense + sparse, BM25 + vector) and re-ranking with cross-encoders

• LLM observability and tracing tools (Arize Phoenix, LangSmith or similar)

• Multilingual NLP, particularly Danish or other Nordic languages

• Knowledge of regulated-industry data handling, GDPR or EU AI Act compliance

• Cloud platforms (e.g. Azure), container registries and CI/CD

What we offer

• Beautiful offices: art on the walls, plenty of green plants and high ceilings

• Great location: bus, train and light rail right outside the door, easy to reach by car, and free parking

• Flexible work: a hybrid setup with the option to work from home up to around 2 days a week after the initial onboarding

• Small organisation: very short decision-making processes and great opportunities for co-responsibility

• Personal development: varied tasks, direct client contact and support for further education

• All phases: you’ll work on everything from definition and solution design to programming and production

• Competitive salary: an attractive compensation package that matches your skills

Please note

• Start date: as soon as possible. We’ll still take the time to find the right person, so we review applications on an ongoing basis and will keep the position open until it’s filled.

• This is a hybrid role based at our office in Viby J., Aarhus. It is not a remote position.

• We cannot offer work permit sponsorship or relocation support. Applicants must already have the right to work in Denmark.

**WHY SPEKTR

**At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

_Compliance, built like product.

_Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

• $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

• Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

• Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**We are looking for an AI Engineer who is, first and foremost, a product builder. In this role, you won't just be running experiments in a notebook; you will own the end-to-end AI strategy and its direct impact on our customers.

In this role, you will own everything related to AI, LLMs, and intelligent automation.

This is a high-impact role in a fast-growing company. We are looking for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, loves solving complex compliance puzzles, and is eager to shape the next generation of compliance technology.

**What You Will Be Doing

**

• AI Strategy & Ownership: Own the end-to-end AI roadmap—from selecting the right models (SOTA commercial vs. fine-tuned open source) to deciding how they are integrated into the product core.

• Agentic Feature Design: Design and deploy LLM-powered features including autonomous agents, advanced RAG pipelines, and intelligent document understanding.

• Product-Led AI: Collaborate directly with founders to translate complex compliance "puzzles" into scalable AI solutions. You own the "Why" behind every model choice.

• Continuous Innovation: Stay at the bleeding edge of AI/ML research, proactively identifying new papers or releases that can give spektr a competitive advantage.

• Engineering for Reliability: Turn non-deterministic AI outputs into deterministic product value. You ensure our agents are accurate, explainable, and hallucination-free.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• The Product Mindset: You are a product person at heart. You care about whether the AI actually solves the user's problem, not just if the loss curve is going down.

• High-Agency Builder: You prefer building systems over following manuals. You identify bottlenecks in our AI workflows and fix them before they become tickets.

• AI/ML Expertise: 2+ years of experience in ML, AI, or Data/Backend roles with a deep understanding of modern LLM stacks.

• Technical Mastery: Strong skills in TypeScript (our core) and/or Python, with hands-on experience in frameworks like LangChain or equivalent orchestration layers.

• RAG & Vector Mastery: You’ve built production-grade RAG pipelines and understand the nuances of embedding, retrieval strategy, and re-ranking.

• Evaluation Obsession: You understand that "it works on my machine" doesn't apply to LLMs. You have experience setting up evaluation frameworks to measure and improve model performance.

• Cloud & Scale: Experience deploying AI services in AWS or containerized environments, ensuring they are scalable and cost-effective.

• Communication: You can explain the trade-offs of a specific model architecture to a founder and a technical bottleneck to a peer with equal clarity.

**OUR TECH INTERESTS

**

• Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and Open Source (LLaMA, Mistral).

• Stack: TypeScript, Python, LangChain, etc

• Infra: AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD for LLMs.

**OUR PROCESS

**

• Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (60 minutes)

**How To Apply

**We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

Shape the future of customer engagement at LEO Pharma — from global design to local impact.

Join us in creating a future legacy in medical dermatology. At LEO Pharma, we are global leaders in medical dermatology, with 115 years of experience bringing innovation to healthcare.

In Global Customer Engagement Platforms & Excellence, we partner across the business to drive customer engagement excellence – empowering global and local teams to execute with impact. We are guided by simplification, collaboration, and accountability. Now, as we embark on a global Customer Engagement Platform implementation affecting around 1500 users across 30+ markets. We are preparing to launch a transformation project and are expanding the team with 2 permanent and 3 temporary Senior Global Business Process Owner roles, who will help define how customer engagement works across LEO — and make it simpler, smarter, and more scalable.

Your role

You will be the business authority for customer engagement processes within your portfolio. You will be the business voice that connects commercial needs with technical delivery - translating needs into process design, requirements, governance, and adoption. You will work closely with global and local stakeholders – bringing deep respect for the knowledge of people living the day-to-day reality – while driving towards global standards that create value for LEO, our customers, and ultimately patients. When decisions are needed for the greater good of LEO and the patients we serve – you drive them through. Global IT and external partners build to your specifications.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Designing and governing scalable customer engagement processes across global and local markets.

• Facilitating cross-functional workshops and driving alignment across Business Units, Commercial Excellence, Medical Affairs, Digital Engagement, and regional teams – and representing your portfolio credibly to senior stakeholders.

• Translating business needs into process flows, user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria with Global IT and external partners.

• Making process design decisions within your portfolio – proceeding when alignment is reached, escalating when it’s not.

• Setting global standards, enabling train-the-trainer models, and ensuring platforms and processes are adopted successfully.

• Owning and prioritising the improvement pipeline, including business cases, benefits, adoption metrics, and continuous optimisation.

You may work across areas such as segmentation, targeting, territory planning, field execution, omnichannel journey enablement (process design, platform configuration and data flow – engagement model and channel strategy are owned by Digital Engagement), Key Account Management, event management, field coaching, analytics, and AI-enabled customer engagement insights.

When you apply, indicate which areas are your primary strength and where you have secondary experience.

Your qualifications

We imagine that you bring solid business process ownership experience from pharmaceutical or life sciences commercial operations. You understand how global platforms support local execution, and you know how to turn ambiguity into clear, practical decisions that move the business forward.

We are especially looking for:

• Extensive experience in business process design and optimisation within pharma or life sciences commercial operations.

• Experience with CRM platforms such as Veeva CRM, Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, or equivalent.

• Proven ability to apply Lean, value stream mapping , Gemba, or similar improvement methods.

• Experience translating business needs into requirements, acceptance criteria, and delivery input for IT or external partners.

• Solid facilitation experience in global, multi-market, and cross-functional environments.

• Strong communication and presentation skills – able to articulate process rationale and build confidence with senior stakeholders.

Experience with CRM transformations, Agile delivery, business case development, pharma compliance processes, data governance, change management, or train-the-trainer models will be an advantage.

As a person, you are collaborative and curious – you genuinely want to understand how people work and what markets need. But you are not consensus-dependent: when the time comes, you decide. You have backbone, think in systems, and create clarity for others rather than accumulating decisions. You communicate in ways that enable others to self-serve, and you default to progress over perfection. You bring a structured approach to solving problems - untangling complexity rather than adding to it.

What success looks like

• Business teams experience you as a trusted partner — someone who makes their work easier through well-designed processes.

• Your processes are adopted and continuously improving — delivering measurable value, not gathering dust.

• Global standards are self-sustaining — through train-the-trainer and local enablement rather than central enforcement.

• You make decisions confidently within your portfolio — creating clarity rather than accumulating decisions.

• The customer experience improves because the processes you govern make it easier for LEO to engage healthcare professionals consistently and at scale.

Your new team

You will join Global Customer Engagement Platforms & Excellence in Ballerup, Denmark. We are a global team working at the intersection of business process, customer engagement, commercial excellence, and platform governance. Together, we partner with markets, functions, Global IT, and external implementation partners to create processes that are adopted, valuable, and built to scale.

A note from the hiring manager

I'm building a team that partners with the business and owns the outcome — not one that waits to be told what to do. A global Customer Engagement Platform implementation is kicking off imminently — and this role will be central to shaping it from the start.

I believe in partnership as the work, real ownership within clear guardrails, and progress over perfection. You are not a requirements scribe passing notes to IT — you shape how processes should work, and IT builds to that specification. If you can walk me through how you've used structured methods to align people and improve something real, I'd like to hear from you.

The opportunity comes with visibility to executive level.

Contact and application

For additional information, please contact Lisa Munkvold, Head of Global Customer Engagement Platforms, LIMUN@LEO-Pharma.com

You do not need to upload a cover letter, but feel free to add a few sentences in your resume or CV on why this position has your interest and which of the process areas above are your primary strength.

Beyond the skin

Join LEO Pharma, a global leader in medical dermatology, as we go beyond the skin to make a lasting impact. Our innovative approach sets us apart. We are dedicated to leaving a legacy that positively impacts patients, colleagues, and our planet.

At LEO Pharma, we believe in the power of individuals to drive change. Our flat organizational structure empowers you to make a visible impact and offers versatile roles for professional growth. We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, recognizing that our different perspectives, backgrounds, and attitudes enable us to make the best decisions. Join our passionate team at LEO Pharma and be yourself as we work together to make a difference.
